book.name: 1 TISALANIKA
book.title: Pol Diki Taay Maaj TISALANIKA Tipa Kidiy Kristen Duw Takwak

content: Nyan gwurak mawul samasam wukidiyan. Alik tikuw, an kap Atins tipaam kwakwak maaj lakatiybiran. Aw adi Godak wukijibir tikwanadi gwalugwa nyan, Timoti, gwurak wayakik. Di anawa yawiy kwurkwanaad Godak. God diki Viyakita Jisas Kraisak bwulakwana Maaj kalivakwanaad. Aw an gwurak wayakitaad gwuraam sugwiyaan kwurdikik apawa Godak wukijibir tigwurkikik. Awarabab sugwiyaan kwurdikik gwura duw nakab bwan kway maargwurkik Jisas Kraisak aw adiy gwurak titaay kwurkwadanadiy kupwaraap sapwurapa java danik tikuw. Aw gwur gwura ab bwu lakwugwura God di diki mayaakw kwadalik, alik adiy nyanak kwurkwadanadiy kupwaraap sapwurapa jaav nyanak yakwanadiy.

Aw nyan kwasa mwiy gwurawa nakamwiyib kwabaal, aw nyan wabadiygwurik adiy jaav gwurak ya maardaal sikir nyanak, adiy duw taakw nyanaam jawjaay kwurkidanadiyan waan. Aw gwur aka bwu lakwugwura day nyanaam jawjaay kwurdaal.

Wun gwurak mwiya samasam wukidiwun. Wun gwuraam lakwuk likil ata ata gwura duw taakw kip apawa Jisas Kraisak wukijibir tinadiygwurik. Alik aw wun Timoti gwurak wayaki-tuwid vara-dikik. Aw wun lakwuk likil Satan bwu lagwu-didiygwurik Jisas Krais tabaam tigwurik, ay gwur apawa kip kwajibir kwanadiygwurik. Aw li Satan lagwu-didiygwur Jisas Krais tabaam tigwurik, aw adiy nyan kwurbadiy yawiy gwuradiy nyidim kipakip tinadiy-adiy.
Timotiy sibinin yakuw Polak maaj wadid.

Aw kita Timoti gwurawa nakamwiyib kwakuw, di bwu anak maa sibinin yaad. Di bwu wadibiran gwur kip apawa Godak wukijibir tinadiygwurik waan. Aw awarwa awarwa titaay mawul yikwanadiygwurik waan. Aw di bwu wadibiran gwur nyanak viyakita mawul yikwagwuradiyan waan. Aw gwur nyanaam vikir mawul mwiya samasam yikwanadiygwurik aw aal nyan gwuraam vikir yikwabanal mawula pik.

Aw kidiy miyawa nyanak yanadiy javawa nyanadiy sipaar yanadiy kagil nyidim tibanaal ab, ki Timoti yakuw yarik yidil gwura akiy maaj li mwugiylik, nyan mwiya rakarak samasam tinadiyan. Aw kita nyan aka bwu lakwubana ya gwur apawa Yitaypika Duw Jisas Kraisak wukijibir tinadiygwurik waan. Aw ki maaj mwugiylik, nyanadiy mawul wiyaw nanadiy.

Aw ki gwura maaj wukin napakuw, nyan aka ya Godak wayapiy sikir rivinadiyan. Aw gwur dikik kip wukijibir tigwuralik tikuw, gwur mwugiy-gwuradiyan nyan mwiya rakarak tibakikik. Aw ki javik tikuw, Godak wayapiy sibanaad.

Nyanyi nyanyi nyi gaan nyan Godak wakwabanaad nyan mawul samasam yinadiyan gwuraam vikir wataay. Aw bas sikwabanaad mayaakw kwadik aw nyan gwuraam varaan jawbakik. Awarab nyan bas sikwabanaad di nyanaam sugwiyaan kwurkwurik gwuraam niki jaav niki jaav lakatiybakik, gwur dikik mwiyir wukijibir tigwurkikik.
Pol Godak bas sidid yaab kwulapwu-dikik dayaam varaan jawuk.
Ayiy, nyan nyanadi Asaay Godawa nyanadi Yitaypika Duw Jisas Krais yaab kwulapwu-birkik nyan gwuraam varaan jawuk.

Wun bas situwaad nyanadi Yitaypika Duw Jisas Kraisak aw awarwa awarwa yikwagwuradiy mawulaam sisuwdikik aw miyawa duw takwaam ap yiwardikik aw mwiya mwiyab nyanadiy gwurak yikwabanadiy mawula pik tidakikik.

Aw gwur atawa tigwurik, di ata sisuwkidadiy gwuradiy mawul mwiya ap samasam tidakikik. Aw nyanadi Yitaypika Duw Jisas Krais dakida adiy miyawa di dikidiy tinadiywa, gwur mwiya mwiyab mwiya viyakit tikinadiygwurik nyanadi Asaay God diki mwutamaam.
